resources.string: Opening the app starts recognition after screen-sharing permission is granted. Results appear automatically when ready. Floating window and map auto-hide options are in Settings.
The window is hidden. Recognition continues in the background; a complete result appears automatically once per round. You can also show the window from the notification.
Recognition continues with the window hidden. Results appear once per round; tap Show floating window to open it now.
Hide automatically on return to map
When any main map button is detected, hide the window and keep recognizing in the background. When enabled, only the draggable Glyph canvas remains. Use the notification to stop recognition.
